red_green: record-red-green.mjs proof under this directory (red_exit 1, green_exit 0) for apps/web/test/live.test.ts against @agora/web vitest project
live_browser_verification: Driven directly in Chrome against a real `node scripts/local-room.ts start` instance: two tabs converge on the same persisted order after a fresh page reload, no duplicate or optimistic-only insertion, keyboard-only send (Tab focus, type, Enter) works, no console error or CSP violation. Two real bugs were found and fixed only by this live drive, not by the unit tests alone: (1) the runtime's ad hoc vite.build() call had no `process.env.NODE_ENV` define, so React threw `process is not defined` and the page silently never mounted; (2) attemptSend compared the Host's local digestText hash (of raw text only) against the server's canonical-command digest, which can never match, causing every accepted send to retry forever. Both are fixed in this commit.
